mode.demon_hunt.name: Emergency Call: Demon
mode.demon_hunt.short: Call received: the Demon is "rescuing" people underground again. Stop him while the city holds
mode.demon_hunt.intro: Somewhere under these blocks sleeps the Demon, one of HeroOut's heroes gone mad. Open up the city, prepare your defenders and wake him when you're ready. Not before.
mode.call.name: Emergency Call
mode.call.short: Every shift is a call on one of the heroes gone mad. Stop them while the city holds
mode.call.intro: Emergency call: {hero} is "rescuing" someone again. His lair is somewhere under these blocks. Open up the city, prepare your residents and crack it open when you're ready. Not before.
mode.call.intro_female: Emergency call: {hero} is "rescuing" someone again. Her lair is somewhere under these blocks. Open up the city, prepare your residents and crack it open when you're ready. Not before.
mode.call.optional: Other heroes on the map are optional. Their arms and legs, however, come in very handy.
mode.coop_call.name: Joint Call
mode.coop_call.short: One call for 2–4 players. Everyone gets a Command Center, the hero is shared
mode.quick.name: Lunch Break Call
mode.quick.short: Five minutes, a small map, one hero. Done before lunch is over
mode.quick.intro: The call came in on your lunch break. HeroOut regulations don't cancel lunch, so you've got five minutes for everything.
difficulty.title: Difficulty
difficulty.intern.name: Intern
difficulty.intern.desc: Threats grow slowly, no guessing needed. First shift, nobody judges.
difficulty.shift.name: Shift
difficulty.shift.desc: As intended. The board is solvable without guessing, if you think.
difficulty.rush.name: Crunch
difficulty.rush.desc: Threats grow fast, the board can be 50/50. Just like the real HeroOut.
difficulty.rush.locked: Crunch unlocks after your first win on Shift
difficulty.rush.unlocked: Crunch unlocked. HeroOut thanks you for your overtime.
rank.champion.desc: Three or four trophies. The kind they put on billboards.
rank.legend.desc: Every slot holds a trophy. Control itself would love to put this one back in the warehouse.
rank.r1.desc: Listed in the database as "expendable enthusiasm". Works for experience. Experience is paid on Fridays.
rank.r2.desc: Answers calls. Their own too, but only off the clock.
rank.r3.desc: Gets a helmet. Issued on signature, returned to the warehouse along with the head.
rank.r4.desc: May rescue without prior approval. Once per shift.
rank.r5.desc: Responsible for everyone. Especially when something goes wrong.
rank.r6.desc: Got an office with a view of the Dome. The windows don't open. The view is company property too.
rank.r7.desc: Your face on billboards. The rights to your face belong to HeroOut.
rank.title: Rank
rank.max: Only the 42nd floor is higher. Nobody gets promoted there. They get summoned.
rank.unlocks_none: A badge and a frame. And the envy of the whole department
status.splice_shield.name: Splice Shield
status.splice_shield.desc: The gel tanks one team: the infected takes half damage from a single player's heroes. Hit it together.
status.teamwork.name: Teamwork
status.teamwork.desc: Heroes of two players hit the same target: +20% damage for all.
ally.beacon.bio: Missing-persons searcher, Beacon service. Found people in tunnels by their breathing alone. Nearly two meters tall, so she sees everything and tells everyone about it.
ally.beacon.desc: Now she finds danger, not you: once a minute reveals the numbers of a 3×3 area at the dig edge.
ally.canopy.bio: Greened the rooftops of Lumen City for forty years, long before HeroOut. The company hired her "as the face of the ads" and issued her gardening drones. Her tomatoes still grow on three skyscrapers.
ally.canopy.desc: Granny is planting what's needed again: Microreactors and digging yield 25% more Energy.
ally.current.bio: Coast guard water rescuer. Pulled more people out of the bay than anyone in the city's history. Can't rest: on vacation he rescued ducks.
ally.current.desc: While on shift, washes burns, poison and cold off heroes and walks on water.
ally.demon.bio: Underground rescuer: subway, mines, the hot pipes of Undersun Works. Four arms to hold up the ceiling and pull people out at the same time. Hasn't seen the sun in twenty years because he was always rescuing someone down below.
ally.demon.desc: Up top, he's finally not afraid: heroes dig 30% faster, and the Demon himself drills a block in 2 seconds.
ally.doctor.bio: Neural interface specialist, Seventy-Three's first body. Knows more about Splice gel than anyone, because he signed the reports nobody read.
ally.doctor.desc: Medicine as prescribed again: every 90 seconds revives a knocked-out hero, and a new part fully heals the hero.
ally.frostline.bio: Medic-rescuer with ice gel. First in at every fire, last one out. Carries two gel tanks and a thermos of tea she's never once been allowed to finish.
ally.frostline.desc: Now she only puts out enemies: all enemies near her are slowed.
ally.hive.bio: City monitoring operator. Hundreds of bee drones watched traffic jams, fires and linden blossoms. The corporation rewrote their task to "rule breakers".
ally.hive.desc: The swarm now watches enemies: once a minute it marks one hidden nest or lair.
ally.kiln.bio: Heavy fire-and-rescue operator. The biggest and kindest guy in the station. Carried people out of fires in his arms, then made them tea. Calls his ceramic arm "Auntie Clay".
ally.kiln.desc: Carries everything on his back again: heroes near Kiln take 20% less damage.
ally.label: Ally
ally.line.beacon.1: It's empty over there, safe to dig. Honestly.
ally.line.beacon.2: Signal's clean. I see no danger. But I'm watching.
ally.line.canopy.1: I planted a little shrub by the reactor. More Energy, you'll see.
ally.line.canopy.2: No swearing in front of the plants. They hear everything.
ally.line.current.1: Water's warm, burns are gone, poison's rinsed off. Back to the fight.
ally.line.current.2: I'm on dry land. Weird feeling.
ally.line.demon.1: Dig? I dig. Stand clear of the drill.
ally.line.demon.2: It's bright here. I like it. Don't tell anyone.
ally.line.doctor.1: Get up. You're not dead. I forbid it.
ally.line.doctor.2: The new arm took perfectly. Don't thank me. Just don't lose it.
ally.line.frostline.1: Enemies slowed. They're cold. I don't mind.
ally.line.frostline.2: Can I have tea now? Hot. Yes, I know.
ally.line.hive.1: The swarm found a nest. Over there. Bzzz.
ally.line.hive.2: The bees are on your side. Honey comes later.
ally.line.kiln.2: I'll carry you out. But only the ones who need it now.
ally.line.lineman.1: Got him! Hit him while I hold him!
ally.line.lineman.2: Harness checked. For real this time.
ally.line.mason.1: Reinforced your houses. With doors this time.
ally.line.n73.1: Your nerves are fine. I checked. Don't ask how.
ally.line.n73.2: The adaptant on the left is ours now. He doesn't know yet.
ally.line.patch.1: Woof! (Found Energy! Bringing it! Not eating it!)
ally.line.seraph.1: Don't stand in the fire. I can't heal you and your philosophy.
ally.line.seraph.2: The halo's on your side. Finally.
ally.line.standard.1: I'm Standard. Just Standard. But I try.
ally.line.standard.2: Another shift? I'm the backup. I'm always on standby.
ally.line.sweep.1: It's clean here. Safe to stand.
ally.line.sweep.2: Spare parts? Hand them over, I'll dispose of them properly.
ally.lineman.bio: High-rise lineman, power-line rescuer. Once hung from a cable over the monorail for six hours, holding a child and a sandwich. Saved the sandwich too.
ally.lineman.desc: Now he secures enemies, very tightly: pulls them to heroes, and hits near him deal shock.
ally.mason.bio: Geotechnician who shored up supports after earthquakes and rubble clearing. Says every disaster is just a badly calculated load.
ally.mason.desc: Reinforces what needs it: buildings 50% sturdier, rubble cleared twice as fast.
ally.n73.bio: HeroOut's experimental neural circuit, a fighting-game hero. The seventy-two circuits before him didn't survive. He can live in any body and is looking for where the body ends and he begins.
ally.n73.desc: Found which side he's on: all heroes attack 20% faster, and every 30 seconds he lures an adaptant over.
ally.note: Allies fight on their own and boost the whole shift. They don't take parts from enemies: they have enough of their own.
ally.patch.bio: HeroOut rescue dog with a mechanical hind leg. Found people under rubble. Employee of the Month eleven times running, paid in cookies.
ally.patch.desc: The good boy is home again: Energy orbs fly to the center twice as fast, and digging yields 10% more.
ally.seraph.bio: Aerial rescuer and healer. Plucked people off skyscraper roofs and healed them mid-air. Kids draw her on every fence: wings, halo and a huge smile.
ally.seraph.desc: Now heals her own: heroes near her regain health.
ally.standard.bio: Backup body S-01. HeroOut kept thousands of them in warehouses "just in case". The case came. Now one copy knows it's not just a copy.
ally.standard.desc: Mass production now works for you: heroes clock in 15% faster.
ally.sweep.bio: Chemical service sanitation officer. Scrubbed the city after factory accidents. The only one who read the labels on every HeroOut canister, so he knows the gel wasn't only medicinal.
ally.sweep.desc: Cleans for real now: nearby heroes ignore scorched ground and poison, and spare parts recycle for double.
unlock.beacon: Win without opening a nest by accident
unlock.beacon.line: I was shouting where you were hiding? To everyone? Oh God. Fine, now I'll shout where not to go.
unlock.canopy.line: Goodness, what have I done. Have you eaten? Let me at least plant you a garden bed. A normal one.
unlock.current.line: Sorry, was I drowning all of you? I thought you were drowning. Now I think it was me.
unlock.demon.line: Up here… it really isn't that scary. I'll come up. Just not all of you at once, please.
unlock.doctor: Give one hero four trophies at once
unlock.doctor.line: You all have someone else's arms. Was that me? That was me. Fine, then at least I'll make sure they take properly.
unlock.frostline.line: I froze the reactor? Sorry. It was warm. It seemed logical.
unlock.hive.line: Swarm disconnected from Control. Bzzz. We're just bees again. Me too.
unlock.kiln.line: Where's the fire? There was no fire? Then why did I… Never mind. Who needs covering now?
unlock.lineman: Trigger the Chain Lightning reaction 50 times
unlock.lineman.line: Untie me, please. No, wait, I've got it. I'm a lineman.
unlock.mason.line: Why did I wall you in? Good question. Let me build something with doors instead.
unlock.n73.line: I'm not an asset. I'm not a copy. I'm Seventy-Three. And now I choose whose shift I'm on.
unlock.patch.line: Woof! (Sorry. I thought it was a game. It was not a game.)
unlock.screen.text: A full pre-outbreak copy has been found: {hero}. This service now joins your shifts with no limits.
unlock.screen.text_female: A full pre-outbreak copy has been found: {hero}. This service now joins your shifts with no limits.
unlock.screen.title: Backup restored
unlock.seraph: Win without losing a single hero
unlock.seraph.line: I was healing the nests? I was healing the nests. Never again. Let me heal you instead.
unlock.standard.line: We… I? I. I think I have a name. I just don't remember which.
unlock.sweep.line: I disinfected you? All of you? Well… at least it's clean. Sorry.
heroes.title: HeroOut Heroes
score.name: Shift score
results.score.title: Shift score
results.score.loss_note: Points count even without a win. HeroOut values effort. It only pays for results.
results.rank.title: Rank
results.progress.title: Closest to returning
results.control_win.1: Incident closed. The bill for the rescue has been sent to the victims.
results.control_win.2: Call closed. Gratitude has been expressed verbally. The bonus will be verbal too.
results.control_win.3: Infected neutralized. Its arm is now your hero's property. Your hero, in turn, is HeroOut property.
results.control_lose.1: Command Center lost. The cost has been deducted from the heroes' salaries.
results.control_lose.2: Shift ended early. Overtime is unpaid. So is undertime.
results.control_lose.3: Heroes have scattered across the city. Please return to the warehouse for the next shift.
dossier.title: Dossier
dossier.hero.unknown.desc: Not met yet. According to Control, no such employee ever existed.
dossier.slots: Team slots: {value}. Next one when {need} return
dossier.stat.lost.note: Control wrote them off as inventory wear and tear.
dossier.records.none: None yet. Records start from zero too
dossier.file.standard.1: Model: backup body S-01. Warehouse No. 4, "just in case" shelf.
dossier.file.standard.2: Incident: got up without a call and clocked in as a trio.
dossier.file.standard.3: Control's note: leaving the warehouse without permission counts as theft. Of themselves.
dossier.file.patch.2: Employee of the Month eleven times running. The twelfth was canceled due to mutiny.
dossier.file.patch.3: Control's note: the asset bites. The asset has a point.
dossier.file.canopy.1: Experience: forty years of rooftop gardening, two of them at HeroOut "as the face of the ads".
dossier.file.canopy.2: Incident: greened an avenue, six cars and one inspector.
dossier.file.canopy.3: Control's note: the inspector is in bloom. No complaints filed.
dossier.file.current.1: Position: coastal rescuer. Most people saved in the city's history.
dossier.file.current.2: Incident: started making people drown himself so there'd be someone to save.
dossier.file.current.3: Control's note: rescue quota exceeded by 300%. Bonus awarded.
dossier.file.lineman.1: Position: high-rise lineman. Hung from a cable for six hours with a child and a sandwich.
dossier.file.lineman.2: Incident: ties citizens to utility poles "so they don't fall".
dossier.file.lineman.3: Control's note: zero falls in the district. Excellent metric.
dossier.file.frostline.1: Position: medic-rescuer with ice gel. First in at a fire, last one out.
dossier.file.frostline.2: Incident: puts out anything warm, including microreactors and tea.
dossier.file.frostline.3: Control's note: no fire detected. Recommendation: extinguish just in case.
dossier.file.mason.1: Position: geotechnician. Believes every disaster is just a badly calculated load.
dossier.file.mason.2: Incident: walled up a residential block "so it wouldn't collapse". It didn't.
dossier.file.mason.3: Control's note: residents inside are safe. An exit was not in the budget.
dossier.file.sweep.1: Position: chemical sanitation officer. The only one who read the labels on the canisters.
dossier.file.sweep.2: Incident: disinfects residents. Thoroughly. Inside and out.
dossier.file.sweep.3: Control's note: what exactly he read is classified.
dossier.file.beacon.1: Position: missing-persons search. Finds people by their breathing alone.
dossier.file.beacon.2: Incident: shines a searchlight and announces the coordinates of everyone she sees.
dossier.file.beacon.3: Control's note: there are no more missing persons in the city. No hidden ones either.
dossier.file.hive.1: Position: city monitoring. Hundreds of bee drones, traffic jams, fires, linden blossoms.
dossier.file.hive.2: Incident: task rewritten to "rule breakers". Everyone is now a rule breaker.
dossier.file.hive.3: Control's note: the honey is still excellent.
dossier.file.kiln.1: Position: heavy fire-rescue operator. Kindest guy in the station.
dossier.file.kiln.2: Incident: carries people out of fires by smashing through walls. There is no fire.
dossier.file.kiln.3: Control's note: the walls were insured. The people were not.
dossier.file.seraph.1: Position: aerial rescuer and healer. Kids draw her on fences.
dossier.file.seraph.2: Incident: heals everyone, enemies included. Airlifts residents "to the hospital".
dossier.file.seraph.3: Control's note: the hospital is full. A second one is being built at the patients' expense.
dossier.file.doctor.1: Position: neural interface specialist. Signed gel reports nobody read.
dossier.file.doctor.2: Incident: "operates" on anyone in reach and hands out other people's limbs.
dossier.file.doctor.3: Control's note: the reports have been read. The reports have been destroyed.
dossier.file.demon.1: Position: Undersun Works underground rescuer. Hasn't seen the sun in twenty years.
dossier.file.demon.3: Control's note: it really is safe down there. Nobody is let back up.
dossier.file.n73.1: Model: experimental neural circuit No. 73. The previous seventy-two were written off.
dossier.file.n73.2: Incident: switches bodies in search of himself.
dossier.file.n73.3: Control's note: employees are forbidden to find themselves. He's already been found. He's on the balance sheet.
challenge.win_without_accidental_open: win without opening a nest by accident
daily.name: Daily Call
daily.short: One map for the whole city. Your first finished attempt counts
daily.done: Counted: {value} pts. Play on for fun
daily.streak_lost: Streak broken. Control has logged an absence.
boon.energy_cache.name: Stash
boon.energy_cache.line: Someone in HeroOut accounting is in for a surprise.
boon.reactor_overclock.name: Reactor Overclock
boon.reactor_overclock.desc: Microreactors yield 30% more Energy. Can be taken twice.
boon.reactor_overclock.line: The manual forbids it. The manual stayed in the cache.
boon.sharp_shovels.name: Sharpened Shovels
boon.sharp_shovels.line: The shovels were written off. Nobody told the shovels.
boon.reinforcements.name: Reinforcements
boon.reinforcements.desc: +2 shift slots. Can be taken twice.
boon.reinforcements.line: Found in the supply closet. Waiting for a shift since last Tuesday.
boon.field_training.name: Field Training
boon.field_training.desc: All heroes trained one level higher, no School needed. Max level 3.
boon.field_training.line: Video course "How Not to Die", four minutes. Three of them are ads.
boon.armor_plates.name: Body Armor
boon.armor_plates.desc: +2 defense to all heroes. Can be taken twice.
boon.armor_plates.line: One size fits all. Pinches everyone equally.
boon.first_aid.name: First Aid Kits
boon.first_aid.desc: Heroes out of combat regain 1 health per second.
boon.first_aid.line: Bandages, plasters and not a drop of gel. That's why they work.
boon.nest_tracker.name: Tip-off
boon.nest_tracker.desc: Reveals the nearest hidden nest or hero lair.
boon.nest_tracker.line: Anonymous call. The voice was suspiciously loud. Very Beacon.
boon.spare_part.name: Warehouse Spare
boon.spare_part.desc: A level 2 part for the hero with the most empty slots.
boon.weak_spot.name: Target Dossier
boon.weak_spot.desc: +25% damage to the call target, its weakness revealed in advance.
boon.weak_spot.line: From the hero's personnel file. The personnel file was company property too.
boon.hotline.name: Hotline
boon.hotline.desc: Heroes clock in 20% faster. Can be taken twice.
boon.hotline.line: The line was rerouted from Sales. Sales dropped. Rescues went up.
boon.pick.title: HeroOut cache: take one
boon.pick.hint: The rest goes back to the warehouse, per inventory
role.scout.name: Scout
role.scout.desc: Digs 30% faster, everyone sees their marks. Hero damage −15%.
role.scout.line: Sees everything. Says some of it. You do the talking.
role.assault.name: Assault
role.assault.desc: Heroes hit 25% harder, +10 health. Dig 25% slower.
role.assault.line: Solves problems by hand. Their own and trophy ones.
role.support.name: Support
role.support.desc: 50% more Energy, buildings 20% cheaper, Medcenter heals the whole team. Hero damage −15%.
role.support.line: Without Support, Assault is just a guy with a heavy arm.
role.engineer.name: Engineer
role.engineer.desc: Buildings 50% sturdier, rubble cleared twice as fast, repairs allies' buildings. Hero damage −10%.
role.engineer.line: Fixes everything the others broke. Plans included.
role.pick.title: Choose a role
rescue.name: Restore Center
rescue.desc: Bring 3 heroes to the ruins and hold for 10 s. The Center returns at 40% integrity.
rescue.done: Center raised! {player} is back on shift.
rescue.spectator: The center wasn't raised. You're watching the rest of the shift from the sidelines.
transfer.name: Send Energy
challenge.win_no_hero_lost: win without losing a single hero
challenge.hero_full_trophies: give one hero four trophies at once
building.home.name: Hero Dorm
building.home.desc: Triple bunks and a shower schedule. Prints heroes up to level 2 and adds +1 shift slot.
building.birth.title: Who clocks in next
building.birth.auto.desc: Sends whoever's element is strongest against the nearest enemy.
building.birth.not_unlocked: Not on your side yet. To unlock: {condition}
building.birth.cap_full: No slots. Build a Hero Dorm
status.stump.name: Stump
status.stump.hint: Take a part for this slot from an enemy, or let the Medcenter regrow it.
unit.resident.name: Hero
resource.residents.name: Heroes
unit.resident_born: A new hero is on shift
cell.mark.hint: Hold a closed block to mark it "Danger" or "Not sure". Swipes skip marked blocks.
boon.peek_numbers.name: Recon Drone
boon.peek_numbers.desc: Pick a block: the drone reveals the numbers of every block in the 3×3 around it.
boon.peek_numbers.line: The drone declined insurance and took off on its own.
site.warehouse.name: Control Warehouse
site.warehouse.desc: Control stores citizens here as company property. Break it open and they run for the Command Center.
site.warehouse.found: Warehouse opened: citizens are running for the Center
site.hostages: Hostages at the nest. Open it and they run for the Center
unit.civilian.name: Citizen
unit.civilian.desc: Doesn't fight, runs fast. Cover them on the way to the Center.
unit.civilian.hiding: A citizen is hiding: dig a path to them
results.medals_none: No medals this shift. Control didn't get a bonus either.
building.outpost.name: Checkpoint
building.outpost.desc: A former HeroOut checkpoint. The turnstile's broken and the land around it is yours now. Edge of your land only.
building.relay.name: Relay
building.relay.desc: Picks up shift rosters from other districts: +1 hero slot above the norm. Pings visible across the map. Control calls this overtime.
building.watchtower.name: Watchtower
building.watchtower.desc: This HeroOut monitoring tower used to watch you. Now every 90 s it reveals the numbers of a nearby 3×3. The thinking is still yours.
building.jammer.name: Splice Jammer
building.jammer.desc: Scrambles the gel's signal. Nearby infected move slower, hit less often, no elements or abilities. Unlocks after your first destroyed nest.
building.backup_lab.name: Backup Archive
building.backup_lab.desc: A server room of nightly copies of everyone who ever wore a HeroOut suit. Replacements print 20% faster. If the Archive stands at shift end, hero unlock progress ×1.5.
building.rotation_center.name: Limb Rotation Center
building.rotation_center.desc: Corporate program "Lend a Hand". Nearby heroes swap trophies. Needs 2 Rescue Schools.
build.requires.nest: Destroy at least one nest first
build.station.digs_none: Digs everything at the same speed
rotation.title: Limb Rotation
rotation.empty: No one nearby. Bring heroes within 2 blocks of the Center
rotation.hint: Drag a trophy onto another hero, or onto a same-slot trophy to swap
site.survivor.name: Control Warehouse
site.survivor.desc: Control stores citizens here as company property. Break it open and they run for the Command Center.
site.survivor.found: Warehouse opened: citizens are running for the Center
lose.text: The base has fallen. Heroes scattered across the city, but replacements will clock in next shift.
building.station.name: Station: {hero}
building.station.desc: A {hero} service post. Dispatches only this hero. The higher the hero's level, the pricier the station.
squad.title: Shift Briefing
squad.slot_next: One more slot after {need} unlocked heroes
squad.max_high: No more than two level 3–4 heroes per squad
squad.auto.desc: Picks heroes whose element hits the enemies' weaknesses
squad.taken.desc: This shift the service is infected and plays against you
squad.resting.desc: Off shift. HeroOut doesn't pay for leave, but allows it
squad.locked: Service not on your side yet
building.station.standard.name: Serial Chassis Depot
building.station.patch.name: Patch's Kennel
building.station.canopy.name: Gardener's Greenhouse
building.station.current.name: Current's Lifeguard Tower
building.station.lineman.name: Lineman's Pylon
building.station.frostline.name: Frostline's Ice Station
building.station.mason.name: Mason's Concrete Yard
building.station.sweep.name: Sweep's Decon Post
building.station.beacon.name: Beacon's Searchlight Post
building.station.hive.name: Hive's Apiary
building.station.kiln.name: Kiln's Fire Station
building.station.seraph.name: Seraph's Helipad
building.station.doctor.name: Doctor's Clinic
building.station.demon.name: Demon's Mine Shaft
building.station.n73.name: Lab N-73
hero.copy.desc: Printed from a HeroOut backup taken before the outbreak. No gel: sane, but weaker than the original.
hero.infected.desc: A living suit wearer. Splice gel made them stronger and madder.
unit.resident.desc: Our replacement: a pre-outbreak hero copy, no gel. Digs, builds and fights. Takes parts from the infected it beats.
backup.draft.desc: The copy is only half-assembled, but it can already work a shift: no ability, 50% health, 70% damage. Only one incomplete copy per squad.
backup.draft.limit: Only one incomplete copy per squad
backup.restored.desc: Ability works. The higher the sync, the stronger the hero.
sync.label: Sync {value}/5
sync.hint: Grows over shifts with this hero: being in the squad, trophies, beating infected of the same service, and shift wins.
sync.max: Full sync. This is as strong as it gets without gel.
card.subtitle: Replacement · pre-outbreak backup
card.ability_off: Abilities don't work on an incomplete copy
mutation.title: Mutation
mutation.label: Mutation: {part}
building.forge.name: Element Forge
building.forge.desc: Recolors a nearby hero's trophy into another element: same power, same slot. 40 Energy, once a minute. HeroOut's branding department is horrified.
building.civ_shelter.name: Citizen Shelter
building.civ_shelter.desc: Rescued citizens live here, up to five per Shelter, each giving 1 Energy every 5 s. Here they're not property. Yet.
building.repair.name: Repair Crew
building.repair.desc: Repairs nearby buildings and rebuilds ruins twice as fast. The only service in the city that fixes instead of rescues.
building.card.upgrading: Upgrading, {time}s left. The building keeps working meanwhile.
building.card.waiting_hero: Waiting for a free hero to do the upgrade.
building.card.upgraded: {building} is now level {level}. Fixed up while we were at it.
building.card.rebuild_hint: Half the price and twice as fast as building from scratch.
building.card.cancel_build_hint: You get all the Energy back.
building.card.cancelled: Construction cancelled. All the Energy is back.
building.card.disabled.enemy_near: Enemies nearby. Fight them off first.
building.card.disabled.max_level: This building is already maxed out
building.card.disabled.no_stump: No hero nearby is missing an arm or leg
building.card.disabled.max_stars: The hero already has 3 stars. There's nothing left to teach.
building.boost.star_desc: Each star gives +10% health and damage until the shift ends. Lost if the hero goes down.
building.boost.train_star.name: Training
building.boost.train_star.desc: A nearby hero goes to train at the School and comes back with a training star. While training, they don't dig or fight.
building.boost.train_star.done: {hero}: +1 star. The diploma comes after the shift.
building.boost.emergency_ration.name: Emergency Rations
building.boost.emergency_ration.desc: Heroes near the Command Center instantly recover half their health.
building.boost.emergency_ration.done: Rations handed out. Best not to ask about the expiry date.
building.boost.field_drill.name: Pep Talk
building.boost.field_drill.desc: The station gathers its crew for a quick briefing. Nearby heroes of this type hit 30% harder for 30 seconds.
building.boost.field_drill.done: Briefing over. Everyone left angry and motivated.
building.boost.urgent_surgery.name: Emergency Surgery
building.boost.urgent_surgery.desc: The Medical Center instantly regrows a hero's lost arm or leg. Their own, not someone else's.
building.boost.urgent_surgery.done: {hero} is in one piece again. No anesthesia needed.
building.boost.element_coat.name: Element Charge
building.boost.element_coat.desc: Pick an element: for 45 seconds the hero's hits use it. Handy for hitting an enemy's weakness.
building.boost.rest.name: Nap Time
building.boost.rest.desc: Wounded heroes hide in the Dorm and heal. Free, like every good thing HeroOut doesn't have.
building.boost.rest.done: The heroes are resting. Don't wake them unless you have to.
building.demolish.low_hp: The building is badly damaged, so you won't get much Energy back.
building.built.command: Command Center in place: hits nearby enemies and heals heroes around it
building.built.station: Station ready: {hero} will be born here
building.built.cooler: Nearby reactors work twice as fast
building.built.school: Heroes come out better trained: +1 level
building.built.medcenter: Heals nearby heroes and regrows lost arms and legs
building.built.outpost: The land around is yours; nearby heroes are tougher
building.built.relay: +1 hero limit above the usual cap
building.built.watchtower: Tower ready: a charge reveals the numbers in a 3×3 area
building.built.jammer: Nearby enemies are slower and lose their elements
building.built.forge: You can recolor trophies to another element
building.built.civ_shelter: Rescued citizens live here and produce Energy
building.up.command.2: Hits harder, heals heroes around it, +1 hero limit
building.up.command.3: Hits across 3 cells, another +1 hero limit, wider land. Needs a School
building.up.home.3: Heroes are born 25% faster, sheltered heroes heal faster
building.up.station.3: The hero comes out with a training star
building.up.school.3: Training is cheaper (30 ⚡) and faster (10 s)
building.up.medcenter.3: Regrows an arm or leg in 30 s
building.up.outpost.2: 160 HP, armor 2, shoots enemies on its own
building.up.watchtower.2: A charge every 60 s, stores up to 3
building.up.jammer.3: Enemies are 45% slower and attack 30% less often
recolor.title: Trophy Recolor
recolor.same: The trophy is already that element
recolor.empty: No heroes with trophies nearby. Bring them within 2 blocks
cell.mark.confirm: Your mark "{mark}". Tap again to clear it and open the block.
site.blueprint.name: Blueprint Fragment
site.blueprint.desc: A scrap of blueprint from the HeroOut archive. Kept between shifts, even if the shift fails.
site.blueprint.done: Blueprint complete: {building} can now be built
site.armor_crate.name: Armor Plate Crate
site.armor_crate.desc: Decommissioned HeroOut armor plates. Go to nearby heroes, those with fewer first.
site.lore_record.name: Control Record
site.lore_record.desc: A HeroOut document someone forgot to shred. Goes to the Dossier, Archive tab.
dossier.archive.locked: Record not found. Look for the blue folder on the sensor.
record.1.title: About the Cat
record.1.text: The cat in the tree on Sunny Street has been logged for the 412th time. The cat is now on the books as a reusable incident. So is the tree. Rescue no more than once a week so as not to devalue the service.
record.2.title: Notice to Dome Residents
record.2.text: Dear residents! Starting Monday, the sky over the Dome is subscription-based. Rain is included in the Plus plan. Sun is in Premium. Darkness is free, for now.
record.3.title: Crane No. 14
record.3.text: — Crane No. 14 goes crazy at 9:14, the patrol passes at 9:15. Please don't mix up the times, last time we rescued the wrong people. — Noted. Suggest running the "Cranes Are Safe" ad at 9:13.
record.4.title: Protocol EVERYONE IS ON CALL
record.4.text: Clause 1. Every citizen is a HeroOut on-call employee. Clause 2. An on-call employee may not decline duty. Clause 3. Clauses 1 and 2 take effect immediately and retroactively.
record.5.title: Splice Gel: Marketing Report
record.5.text: The gel regrows lost limbs. Sometimes someone else's. Sometimes extra ones. Proposed slogan: "Sometimes it's a bonus." Safety objects. Safety has been moved to the warehouse.
record.6.title: Memo to Replacements
record.6.text: You are not the original. The original is busy or infected. Do not look for them, do not talk to them, and do not take their limbs without a waybill. Your memory is company property; handle with care.
record.7.title: Citizen Storage Rules
record.7.text: Store citizens at +18°C, in a dry place, this side up. Talking on shelves is prohibited, except "thank you, HeroOut". Escaping the warehouse counts as damage to property.
record.8.title: Reply from the 42nd Floor
record.8.text: — Is the shift over? — The shift never ends. — Then when do employees rest? — Rest is included in the Premium plan. Employees are on Basic.
record.9.title: Underground Department
record.9.text: The underground rescuer exceeded the downward evacuation plan by 400%. No upward evacuation plan was ever issued. Recommendation: issue one. Downward.
record.10.title: S-01 Inventory
record.10.text: There were 1,200 S-01 reserve bodies. By morning there were 1,197. By afternoon three came back and brought three more, identical. Recount suspended: the bodies ask not to be numbered.
blueprint.kind.building: Blueprint of a new building. Fragments stay even if the shift is lost.
blueprint.kind.hero: Fragment of a hero backup. Six fragments restore it completely.
blueprint.locked: {name}: blueprint {have}/{need}. Fragments lie under blocks: look for the blue window with a blueprint icon.
blueprints.title: Blueprints complete: {have}/{need}
blueprints.hint: New buildings unlock with blueprints. Fragments lie under blocks: the blue sensor window with a blueprint icon.
archive.title: Control records: {value}
archive.empty: No records yet. Control insists there never were any. Look for the blue sensor window with a folder icon.
archive.no_text: This record is classified. Even from you.
archive.found: Control record found. It's already in the Dossier, Archive tab.
tech.thermo.desc: Flame, heat and steam. Sets things on fire. Strongest against Toxin.
tech.cryo.desc: Ice and cold. Slows and freezes. Strongest against Fire.
tech.volt.desc: Electricity. The charge jumps to nearby enemies. Strongest against Ice.
tech.toxin.desc: Poison and chemicals. Poisons and lowers defense. Strongest against Impact.
tech.impact.desc: Rams and pistons, just a really hard hit. Stuns and knocks back. Strongest against Lightning.
tech.cycle: Lightning beats Ice, Ice beats Fire, Fire beats Toxin, Toxin beats Impact, Impact beats Lightning.
reaction.thermoshock.desc: A burning target got hit with Ice: double damage, the fire goes out.
reaction.chain.desc: A frozen target got hit with Lightning: the charge jumps to two more.
reaction.shell_break.desc: A burning target got hit with Impact: no defense for 3 seconds.
reaction.burnout.desc: A poisoned target got set on Fire: the burn is twice as strong.
reaction.neuro.desc: A poisoned target got hit with Lightning: stunned for a second.
resist.hint: Every trophy arm has its own element: it hits with that element and protects against it. The hero picks which arm to swing on their own, and always picks the one that works best against the enemy.
enemy.adaptant_thermo.name: Fire Adaptant
enemy.adaptant_cryo.name: Ice Adaptant
enemy.adaptant_volt.name: Sparking Adaptant
enemy.frostline.desc: Medic-rescuer with ice gel. Still putting out fires: she ices everything warm, even microreactors.
part.thermo_arm.label: FIRE ARM
part.cryo_arm.label: ICE ARM
part.volt_arm.label: SPARKING ARM
tip.13: Tip: not sure? Hold a block and mark it "Unsure". It's free. For now.
tip.14: Tip: blueprints and backup fragments you find stay with you, even if the shift fails. HeroOut doesn't approve.
tip.15: Tip: the Shift Briefing shows which services have gone rogue. Pick heroes whose element beats them.
tip.16: Tip: a hero with an incomplete copy can still join the squad. Just one, no ability, but right now.
tip.17: Fact: dozens of firefighters wear the Kiln suit. They share one callsign, and HeroOut owns it.
loading.step.2: Counting citizens. And their arms and legs…
loading.banner: Lumen City. Just another workday at HeroOut.
control.bark.demolish: Demolition of property recorded. The property was yours, but we're upset anyway.
pause.restart_confirm: The current shift will count as a loss. Start over?
pause.restart_host_ask: The host wants to restart the shift. Do you agree?
settings.wipe.step1.title: Erase all progress?
settings.wipe.step1.lead: All of this will be gone:
settings.wipe.item.dossier: the Dossier and the Control records archive
settings.wipe.step1.cloud: Progress will be erased on your other devices too.
settings.wipe.step1.keeps: Your settings, sign-in and best score on the world leaderboard will stay.
settings.wipe.step2.check: I understand that everything will be erased and can't be restored
settings.wipe.step3.control: Control thanks you for voluntarily surrendering your property. The inventory has already been drawn up.
settings.wipe.done: Progress erased. The city is waiting for its commander again.
tempo.label: Tempo
raid.call_early_done: Raid called early. Control appreciates your initiative and will invoice you for it.
event.call.timeout: You didn't answer. Control chose for you. As usual.
event.buyback.title: Customer Buyback
event.buyback.text: Control offers to buy your citizens back. Ten percent off, today only.
event.buyback.a_result: Deal closed. The citizens have been moved to the "discounted" section.
event.buyback.b_result: Refusal noted. A raid has left a bit early to visit you, no hard feelings.
event.dome_audit.title: Dome Inspection
event.dome_audit.text: Scheduled Dome safety inspection. Please switch off everything that works.
event.dome_audit.a_result: Inspection passed. The heroes got armor plates, one per person.
event.dome_audit.b_result: Inspection refusal recorded. The fine was deducted from your Command Center. Literally.
event.ad_shoot.title: Ad Shoot
event.ad_shoot.text: Marketing needs a real hero for an ad. Ideally one who looks like a hero.
event.ad_shoot.a_result: The ad is done. The hero smiles in it; we had to pay extra. Here's your fee.
event.ad_shoot.b_result: Then we'll film a Standard. At least he doesn't blink.
event.overtime.title: Overtime
event.overtime.text: We're offering overtime: Energy now, and we'll turn the threat up a little. You're on shift anyway.
event.overtime.a_result: Energy credited. So is the threat. We always pay in advance.
event.overtime.b_result: The labor code was found in the archive. Under "Fiction".
event.inventory.title: Inventory Check
event.inventory.text: An inventory check is underway. One of your buildings is listed as surplus. Will you hand it over voluntarily?
event.inventory.a_result: Building seized. A blueprint scrap turned up inside; you can keep it. We don't need it, we drew it.
event.inventory.b_result: Payment received. The building is yours again until the next check.
event.pr_campaign.title: PR Campaign
event.pr_campaign.text: We need a spectacular fight for a PR campaign. We'll send you some enemies, you win beautifully, everyone's happy.
event.pr_campaign.a_result: Enemies released. Cameras rolling. Smile while you fight.
event.pr_campaign.b_result: Pity. A fight without cameras doesn't count as real heroism.
event.budget_cut.title: Budget Cut
event.budget_cut.text: The district budget has been optimized. You can chip in yourself, or construction gets pricier for a while.
event.budget_cut.a_result: Thanks for chipping in. Your humblest building got a free upgrade. Almost free.
event.budget_cut.b_result: Construction costs are up for a minute. Prices will come back down. They usually don't, but these will.
event.drone_rent.title: Drone Rental
event.drone_rent.text: Scout drone for rent. It shows the numbers under the quarantine tape. Hourly rate; an hour lasts as long as we say.
event.drone_rent.a_result: The drone is yours for two flights. Scratches are billed separately.
event.hazard_bonus.title: Hazard Pay
event.hazard_bonus.text: We're ready to pay a double bonus for the next nest. We did feed it a little, though.
event.hazard_bonus.a_result: Great. The nest is already growing. So is the bonus.
event.hazard_bonus.b_result: The nest stays on a diet. So does the bonus.
event.compliance.title: Safety Briefing
event.compliance.text: Mandatory safety briefing. You'll dig slower, but correctly and for money.
event.compliance.a_result: Briefing complete. The heroes dig carefully and eye their shovels with suspicion.
event.compliance.b_result: Absence recorded. Fine deducted. The briefing counts as attended; we're not monsters.
event.cat.title: Cat in a Tree
event.cat.text: Incoming call: cat in a tree. Four hundred and thirteenth time. Regulations say you must respond.
event.cat.a_result: Cat rescued and unimpressed. The hero earned experience and a scratch.
event.cat.b_result: Call ignored. A fine has been issued. The cat got one too.
event.census.title: Asset Census
event.census.text: An asset census is underway. All assets, please hold still.
event.census.a_result: Census complete. You have been counted. Forever.
event.census.b_result: Assets that dodge the census are counted twice.
event.gel_sample.title: Free Gel Sample
event.gel_sample.text: A free sample of Splice gel! Apply to a hero and observe.
event.gel_sample.a_result: The sample worked. The hero has a new arm. Don't ask whose.
event.gel_sample.b_result: Sample disposed of. Disposal costs 20 Energy.
event.hotline.title: Hotline
event.hotline.text: You've reached the HeroOut hotline. Oh wait, we called you. How can we help?
event.hotline.a_result: Help is on the way. It's an intern. He's trying his best.
event.hotline.b_result: Thank you for not using our services. Here's a loyalty bonus.
event.insurance.title: Insurance
event.insurance.text: Want to insure your Command Center against infection? Infection is not a covered event, of course.
event.insurance.a_result: Policy issued. You can read the fine print later. We're still writing it.
event.insurance.b_result: Taking risks is noble. And free, for now.
event.limb_recall.title: Limb Recall
event.limb_recall.text: Arm batch No. 4012 has been recalled by the manufacturer. Please return them before the shift ends.
event.limb_recall.a_result: Arm received at the warehouse. Compensation transferred. The arm misses you.
event.limb_recall.b_result: We understand. A recovery specialist is on the way.
event.loyalty.title: Loyalty Points
event.loyalty.text: You've earned HeroOut loyalty points. Spend them now, or let them expire at midnight?
event.loyalty.a_result: Discount applied. We still made money on it.
event.loyalty.b_result: Points saved. They'll expire some other time, when you're not ready.
event.optimization.title: Optimization
event.optimization.text: We've optimized your squad. One hero has been deemed redundant.
event.optimization.a_result: Optimization complete. The rest are working harder now. Out of fear.
event.optimization.b_result: Appeal accepted. Legal sent an invoice. Legal always sends an invoice.
event.party.title: Office Party
event.party.text: Today is the HeroOut office party. Attendance is mandatory, fun is optional.
event.party.a_result: The party was a success. Management sang. The heroes came back angry.
event.party.b_result: Your absence has been noted in your file. In red.
event.premium.title: Premium Plan
event.premium.text: Your Dome free trial has ended. Upgrade to Premium? Air included.
event.premium.a_result: Plan activated. The air is now two percent airier.
event.rebrand.title: Rebranding
event.rebrand.text: The branding team is repainting the city in corporate colors. Your buildings are off-brand.
event.rebrand.a_result: Buildings repainted. Now they're recognizable and slightly armored.
event.rebrand.b_result: Buildings without a logo are considered unclaimed. Someone's already coming for them.
event.rent.title: Land Rent
event.rent.text: The land under your buildings belongs to HeroOut. Your rent invoice is attached.
event.rent.a_result: Payment received. The land is still ours, but you may stand on it.
event.rent.b_result: Your position has been noted. So has the bulldozer.
event.resettle.title: Resettlement
event.resettle.text: Residents of a nearby block will be relocated to a warehouse. For their own safety.
event.resettle.a_result: The relocation went smoothly. The warehouse welcomes its new residents.
event.resettle.b_result: Relocation disrupted. The residents are running to you. So is the convoy.
event.survey.title: Quality Survey
event.survey.text: Please rate the quality of the infection in your district. The survey takes no more than a minute of your life.
event.survey.a_result: Thank you! Your answer is very important to us and has already been lost.
event.survey.b_result: Call dropped. We'll call back. With backup.
event.viral.title: Viral Video
event.viral.text: Your hero went viral. HeroOut wants to buy the rights to their face.
event.viral.a_result: Rights sold. The hero now has a HeroOut face. It smiles on its own.
event.viral.b_result: Video deleted. Along with the likes and the sense of humor.

call.overtime.line: Reminder: your shift has been extended. Overtime is unpaid, but deeply appreciated.
call.overtime.a_result: The heroes are fired up. The fire is in lieu of a bonus.
call.overtime.b_result: The labor code was found in the archive. Under "Fiction".

event.survivor_slot: A citizen made it to safety. They'll say thanks later; right now they're running.
cell.mark_caution.hint: Hold a closed block to mark it "Danger" or "Unsure". Swipes skip marked blocks.
universe.title: The PARTSHIFT World
universe.lead: A city under a Dome, rescuers in exosuits and a company that counts citizens as its property. Here are their stories, before HeroOut classifies them.
call.vote_hint: Everyone votes. The host breaks a tie.
call.cost.returnsWithStar: comes back with a training star
medal.shifts.name: Clocked In
medal.shifts.joke: Attendance recorded. Pay is not included, but attendance is recorded.
medal.wins.name: Call Closed
medal.wins.joke: Call closed. A new one is already open. We never take breaks.
medal.wins_crunch.name: Crunch Survivor
medal.wins_crunch.joke: Crunch has been declared standard. Congratulations on your new standard.
medal.lunch.name: Lunch on Schedule
medal.lunch.joke: Lunch counted. Digestion will be accounted for next quarter.
medal.daily.name: No Days Off
medal.daily.joke: A day off is just a day you forgot to log in.
medal.dig.name: Digger
medal.dig.joke: Every block dug with love. The love is written off as shovel wear.
medal.wave.name: Domino
medal.wave.joke: One block opened another. We call that a supply chain.
medal.chord.name: Accordionist
medal.chord.joke: HR asks that you play more quietly.
medal.defuse.name: HeroOut Sapper
medal.defuse.joke: The mines were HeroOut property. The bill for defusing them is on its way.
medal.nests.name: Sanitation
medal.nests.joke: Nests destroyed. The gel inside was still under warranty.
medal.enemies.name: Disposal Department
medal.enemies.joke: Each one defeated was an asset. The assets thank you posthumously.
medal.heroes.name: Back in Line
medal.heroes.joke: Employee stopped. He wasn't due for leave, but he got some rest anyway.
medal.super.name: BAM!
medal.super.joke: Strike volume exceeds the limit. The limit has been raised.
medal.reactions.name: Natural Disaster
medal.reactions.joke: The natural disaster is insured. Yours isn't.
medal.trophies.name: Second Hand
medal.trophies.joke: Used limbs in good condition. The previous owners didn't object. Anymore.
medal.builder.name: Developer
medal.builder.joke: Building without a permit. We'll issue one as soon as you stop building.
medal.upgrades.name: Major Repairs
medal.upgrades.joke: Major repairs done. It usually takes us forty years.
medal.civilians.name: Property Rescued
medal.civilians.joke: Citizens returned. The inventory doesn't match, but we'll draw it in.
medal.caches.name: Treasure Hunter
medal.caches.joke: Everything you found was lost by us. On purpose.
medal.blueprints.name: Architect
medal.blueprints.joke: The blueprints are classified. You've seen them. That's classified too.
medal.records.name: Archive Reader
medal.records.joke: The records were for internal use only. You're inside now.
medal.calls.name: Always Picks Up
medal.calls.joke: Thank you for staying on the line. We're not going anywhere either.
medal.clean_sweep.name: Flawless
medal.clean_sweep.desc: A win with no nests opened by mistake and no mines set off
medal.clean_sweep.joke: A flawless shift. Suspiciously flawless. We'll look into it.
medal.no_losses.name: Everyone Came Back
medal.no_losses.desc: A win without losing a single hero
medal.no_losses.joke: All employees returned. The compensation department is confused.
medal.full_limbs.name: Full Set
medal.full_limbs.desc: One hero carrying four trophies at once
medal.full_limbs.joke: Trim level: Maximum. Warranty does not cover other people's parts.
medal.fast_win.name: Early Hand-In
medal.fast_win.desc: A win on Shift in under 8 minutes
medal.fast_win.joke: Shift handed in early. The remaining time will be deducted.
medal.fire_tempo.name: On Fire
medal.fire_tempo.desc: Max tempo for three straight minutes
medal.fire_tempo.joke: Enthusiasm fire detected. A fire extinguisher is on its way.
medal.early_raids.name: Bring It On
medal.early_raids.desc: Three raids called early, and the shift won
medal.early_raids.joke: You called the raid yourself. Three times. We've logged it as voluntary consent.
medal.showcase_hint: Pick up to three medals. They'll show on the leaderboard and in the lobby.
medal.showcase_full: Showcase is full: remove a medal first
cell.hint.help: Numbers count neighboring blocks. Red: nests and hero lairs. Purple: the call target. Blue: caches and warehouses with citizens.
newin.title: New this shift
newin.nests.title: Nests
newin.nests.text: Splice nests hide under the tape. The numbers hint where they are. An opened nest releases enemies.
newin.raids.title: Raids
newin.raids.text: Every so often the infected march on your base. The raid timer is at the top. You can call them early for Energy.
newin.enemy_hero.title: Infected hero
newin.enemy_hero.text: A whole service crew has snapped. They're stronger than regular enemies, but you can take an arm or a leg from them.
newin.elements.title: Elements
newin.elements.text: Heroes and arms have elements. Lightning beats Ice, Ice beats Fire, Fire beats Toxin, Toxin beats Impact, Impact beats Lightning.
newin.goal.title: Call target
newin.goal.text: Now the shift has a main target: one infected hero. Stop them and the call is closed.
newin.mines.title: Mines and capsules
newin.mines.text: There can be mines and supply capsules under the tape. Better to defuse the mine and open the capsule.
newin.tempo.title: Tempo and Control calls
newin.tempo.text: Play fast and your tempo rises and helps. Stand still and Splice builds up. Sometimes Control calls with an offer worth thinking about.
newin.buildings.title: New buildings
newin.buildings.text: Second-tier buildings are open: Outpost, Watchtower, Jammer and more. Find them in the build menu.
campaign.shift.1.title: Sunny Street
campaign.shift.1.new: Splice nests hide under the tape. The numbers show how many are nearby. Opening nests without a license is prohibited, but nobody has a license.
campaign.shift.2.title: Industrial Zone
campaign.shift.2.new: Now the infected come to you on their own. That's called a raid. And somewhere nearby is a Control Warehouse full of citizens: open it and they'll run to you.
campaign.shift.3.title: Seaside Promenade
campaign.shift.3.new: A service crew has snapped in this district. An infected hero is stronger than regular enemies, but you can take an arm or a leg off them. We call that asset reallocation.
campaign.shift.4.title: Reactor Block
campaign.shift.4.new: The blocks burn, freeze and spark. Every hero has an element, and now you pick the squad for the shift. Choose the ones whose element beats the enemy.
campaign.shift.5.title: HeroOut Plaza
campaign.shift.5.new: The shift now has a main target: one infected hero. Stop them and the call is closed. If you're late, they'll come out on their own at 12:00.
campaign.shift.6.title: Old Subway
campaign.shift.6.new: There can be mines and supply capsules under the tape. Defuse the mine, open the capsule. We don't recommend mixing them up.
campaign.shift.7.title: Business District
campaign.shift.7.new: The faster you work, the higher your tempo and the more empty blocks open at once. Also, Control will call today. Pick up, it's in your interest. Mostly ours.
campaign.shift.8.title: Bedroom District
campaign.shift.8.new: Blueprints turn up in caches, and new buildings are open. And lairs no longer wait: an alarm sounds 30 seconds before a hero comes out.
campaign.shift.9.title: Heating Main
campaign.shift.9.new: The nests here are bigger and meaner. Control insists it's just a good harvest.
campaign.shift.10.title: Harbor Warehouses
campaign.shift.10.new: You can now call a raid early and earn Energy for every second saved. We appreciate initiative and will invoice you for it.
campaign.shift.11.title: Foot of the Tower
campaign.shift.11.new: Two strong lairs in one district. Did we promise it would be easy? We did not.
campaign.shift.12.title: Floor Minus Forty-Two
campaign.shift.12.new: The final shift, right under the tower where the gel was brewed. The call target here is the toughest yet. Control wishes you luck and has already taken out insurance. On itself.
campaign.title: Shifts
campaign.done: All 12 shifts complete. Free shift, Crunch, Daily Call and Lunch Break Call are now open. Control is surprised.
target.early_wake: The call target sensed trouble and is coming out early: in {time}
